summary: End-to-end verification of the hosted public form page (/f/{public_token}) + Messages rendering fix. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass (public schema exposes new song_pick keys search_url + result_fields; /f/{token} SPA HTML served without auth; POST with required song empty -> 422; full submit with a song persists and admin GET /api/submissions returns cover+title+artist+preview intact; regression on text/email/number/tel/textarea/select/checkbox still works). Frontend E2E: opened /f/{token} in a fresh incognito browser context (no auth cookies) -> data-testid=public-form rendered; pf-naam and pf-plaat-search present; submit while required song empty triggered public-form-error (server 422); search 'coldplay' returned 12 results with 12 song-add-{id} + 12 song-play-{id} buttons; add -> song-sel-0 with cover + play button; public-form-submit -> public-form-success shown. In Messages: submission 'Alice/Yellow/Coldplay' rendered with cover img + working song-play-{id} button (screenshot confirms). FormEditor integration panel: copy-formpage-url and copy-schema-url present and /f/{token} URL surfaced.
critical_code_review_comments: PublicForm.jsx: submit_url comes from schema (server-side FRONTEND_URL env). If REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and FRONTEND_URL diverge, the hosted page will POST to a different host than the one that served the page — carried over from prior iteration.

PublicForm.jsx: the /f/{token} page currently only shows 'This form does not exist.' or the form; there is no explicit HTTP 404 status for crawlers/monitoring. Optional SEO/robots-noindex meta not set on the public page.
server.py: /api/ root still returns 'vMix Overlay Studio API' (branding leftover).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_HostedFormPage_UI + TEST_PublicFormPage + TEST_ScalarRegression forms and their submissions during the run; all deleted afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hosted form page testids: public-form, pf-{key}, pf-{key}-search, song-add-{id}, song-play-{id}, song-sel-{n}, song-remove-{n}, public-form-submit, public-form-success, public-form-error. Server exposes new per-field keys search_url + result_fields on song_pick fields plus top-level song_search_url/submit_url/honeypot_field. FormEditor testids: copy-formpage-url + copy-schema-url. Public /f/:token route requires no auth; use a fresh browser context or requests.Session with no cookies. iTunes proxy is live.
rca of the issue: Original bug ('plaat did not show up in Messages' + 'no play/+ button on the form') root cause was that the user had built their own form UI from the raw JSON schema — it can't render play/add controls. Fix delivered by main agent: hosted /f/{token} SPA page that renders the full form (incl. SongPicker with play + add buttons), schema now self-describes song_pick fields via search_url/result_fields, and Messages renders the persisted song object as cover img + title + artist + play button. All three angles verified end-to-end in this iteration.
